FinTech & B2B Cloud Payments
1,450 employees across 3 European hubs (Milan, Berlin, Amsterdam)
Senior Software Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers (80 open roles this year)

Raw CSV review feed also contains 3 unverified rows mentioning 'weekend shop shift rotation' imported from an external merchant POS pilot.

SCENARIO_B_EUROFREIGHT_LOGISTICS
EuroFreight Interport S.r.l.
Freight Transport & Interport Logistics
1,600 employees across 5 major logistics hubs (Verona, Milan, Bologna, Rome, Naples)
Licensed Commercial Truck Drivers (C-CQC) and Warehouse Operators (120 urgent openings)
Multi-site interport hub network, frontline mobile-first workforce. Declared EVP: 'National leader in integrated freight transport.'

Reviews across the 5 interport hubs show strong scores on payroll reliability (4.7/5) and modern Euro-6 fleet safety (4.5/5), but high rating variance across locations (Verona/Milan at 4.3/5 vs. Bologna/Naples at 3.1/5 due to slow candidate response and local warehouse onboarding friction). Local hub reviews are tracked manually in spreadsheets.

Career portal receives 14,000 monthly visits (82% from smartphones), but 63% of visitors drop off before completing the application form because it requires desktop-style account registration and a 5-page CV upload. Job descriptions use generic corporate HQ templates that omit C-CQC route allowances, home-time predictability, and fleet specs.
Corporate LinkedIn page reaches white-collar freight clients and HQ analysts well, but has near-zero reach among licensed C-CQC drivers and interport warehouse operators.
99.4% on-time payroll accuracy, modern Euro-6 fleet (<2.5 years average vehicle age), and 91% annual retention among tenured (>2 years) long-haul C-CQC drivers.

HQ commercial/admin roles (140 staff in Verona) hire smoothly in 24 days via LinkedIn. The acute bottleneck is exclusively on the 120 frontline C-CQC driver and warehouse operator openings across the regional hubs—especially Bologna and Naples—where average Time-to-Hire has reached 43 days.

Because of the 43-day Time-to-Hire, Operations is burning €190k/quarter on emergency temporary staffing agencies. The 3-person central HR team wastes over 110 hours/year manually copying hub reviews into Excel and lacks a unified ROI dashboard for the Board.

The Marketing Director proposes launching a B2B technical LinkedIn blog series to attract drivers, while Regional Hub Directors demand deploying a new mobile fast-apply widget and rewriting job ads tomorrow morning before running any portal UX or driver persona audits.

EuroFreight operates 5 major logistics hubs with 1,600 employees and urgently needs to hire 120 licensed Commercial Drivers (C-CQC) and warehouse operators to fulfill new freight contracts. While tenured driver retention (91%), on-time pay (4.7/5), and the modern Euro-6 fleet are major internal strengths—and HQ admin hiring on LinkedIn works smoothly—63% of career page visitors drop off before completing the application form, and frontline Time-to-Hire has ballooned to 43 days, forcing expensive reliance on temporary staffing agencies. Most driver candidates browse on smartphones during breaks, facing a multi-page desktop registration form and generic corporate job descriptions that fail to mention EuroFreight's reliable driver pay and modern vehicle fleet. Furthermore, employee reviews across the 5 hubs are tracked manually in spreadsheets, leaving HR without quantitative ROI metrics for the Board while Marketing suggests a LinkedIn blog series.

SCENARIO_C_VERDECARE_BCORP
VerdeCare & Formulation Group (Certified B Corp)
Multi-Site Healthcare, Wellness & B-Corp Formulation
2,100 employees across 50 regional care centers and 2 R&D wellness formulation labs
Clinical Healthcare Professionals (Nurses, Therapists) and Gen-Z Early-Career Lab/Clinical Specialists

Multi-site regional care network + formulation labs, Certified B-Corp sustainability governance, strict CFO budget auditability. Declared EVP: 'Sustainable human care, clinical excellence, and certified B Corp social impact.'

Overall employee sentiment is highly positive (4.4/5 average, high EVP authenticity, zero Say-Do Gap or systemic burnout). However, across the 50 regional care centers, local Google and Indeed facility reviews are unmonitored centrally, leaving 18 regional clinics with outdated or unaddressed local profiles.

University Career Day and post-interview candidate feedback for Gen-Z clinical and formulation graduates is collected via disconnected paper sheets and ad-hoc forms (<18% response rate), hiding interview bottlenecks at regional clinics.

35 enthusiastic clinicians and lab researchers already share authentic posts on LinkedIn with high peer trust, but corporate brand channels have low organic reach and HR spends over 150 hours/year manually collecting facility reviews and chasing post screenshots from the 35 ambassadors in spreadsheets.

Internal employee satisfaction (88% B-Corp pride score), EVP authenticity, and annual retention in the R&D formulation labs (93%) are already strong—there is no internal Say-Do Gap or management burnout crisis, and 35 organic ambassadors are already active.

The 2 central R&D formulation labs enjoy high applicant flow, whereas 18 regional senior care centers lack local passive candidate awareness among nurses and therapists, and Gen-Z university Career Day candidates drop out during slow local facility interview handoffs.

The 4-person central People team loses 150+ hours/year on manual spreadsheet tracking of facility reviews and ambassador screenshots. The CFO requires certified Earned Media Value (EMV in EUR) and auditable B-Corp candidate experience metrics before approving the next annual HR budget.

An external branding agency pitched a 6-month corporate EVP overhaul from scratch, while the Talent Director wants to immediately turn on automated ambassador tracking across all 50 facilities tomorrow without first auditing local facility reputation or formalizing the regional clinic ambassador cohort.

VerdeCare is a certified B Corp operating 50 regional care centers and 2 wellness formulation labs (2,100 employees). Internal employee satisfaction and EVP authenticity are already strong (no internal Say-Do Gap or burnout crisis), and the company already has 35 enthusiastic employees sharing posts on LinkedIn. However, the HR team wastes over 150 hours/year manually collecting local facility reviews across the 50 care centers and chasing screenshots from ambassadors on spreadsheets. Corporate social channels have low organic reach into regional clinical talent pools, post-interview and university Career Day candidate feedback is fragmented across isolated forms, and the CFO requires certified Earned Media Value (EMV) and auditable B Corp candidate experience metrics before approving the next annual HR budget.
